source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: A photorealistic 3D-rendered scene of a moody pharmaceutical research lab at night, wide cinematic aspect ratio. Center: a large glowing holographic DNA double helix floating above a polished dark grey metal lab bench, rendered in translucent teal-cyan glass with gold-orange atom nodes, connected to a small glowing molecular ring structure at its lower right. Left side: a semi-transparent teal holographic panel angled toward the viewer with bold white sans-serif header text "EvidenceGrade AI", below it a label "5-tier grade" and a vertical stack of five colored grade bars labeled "A" (green), "B" (teal), "C" (yellow-olive), "D" (orange), "F" (red); to the right of the bars a line chart titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with a rising teal line on a grid, y-axis ticks 0 to 60, and the same caption "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" repeated beneath the chart. Background wall: pale grey plaster with two floating white shelves holding amber glass pill bottles with white labels reading "Aspirin", "Warfarin", "Ibuprofen" (partially blurred), a rack of test tubes, black binders, and a potted monstera plant; a brass vintage microscope sits on a lower steel counter. Ceiling: three retro brass articulated pendant lamps, two with warm brass shades casting warm glow and one with a green glass shade. Right side: a large arched window with black frames, rain-streaked glass looking out onto a wet neon-lit street with glowing pink, cyan, and red vertical Chinese/Japanese neon signs, a black cat silhouette sitting on the window sill next to a folded dark red umbrella. Foreground: an open spiral notebook with brown leather cover and handwritten notes, the right page clearly reading "CYP3A4 interaction risk" in black ink with a black fountain pen resting on it; to the right a white ceramic cup with teal lid on a crackle-glazed white saucer. Lighting: dramatic mix of cool teal hologram glow and warm tungsten lamp light, subtle reflections on the glossy bench, soft volumetric atmosphere, shallow depth of field. Style: hyperrealistic octane render, cyberpunk-meets-scientific-illustration aesthetic, high detail, 4k.
